# WisdomTree Reports Monthly Metrics for October 2026


November 11, 2026 6:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_239d63b42fdd453a0a0109fba2dec579/wisdomtree/news/2026-11-11_WisdomTree_Reports_Monthly_Metrics_for_October_815.pdf)


*Over $15.2 billion of net inflows year-to-date, a ~13% annualized organic growth rate*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- WisdomTree, Inc. (NYSE: WT), a modern global asset manager, today released monthly metrics for October 2026, including assets under management (AUM) and flow data by asset class.


Note: The table and commentary below exclude AUM and flows related to private assets managed by Ceres Partners, LLC, which had approximately $2.1 billion in AUM at September 30, 2026. This information is reported with our quarterly earnings results.


Commentary:


- Generated over $1.6 billion of net inflows in October, bringing year-to-date net inflows to over $15.2 billion, representing a 13% annualized pace of organic growth
- Continued strong UCITS ETF momentum, with $450 million of net inflows in October and approximately $6 billion of net inflows through October, representing a 59% annualized organic growth rate
- Despite a challenging market backdrop, our equity products demonstrated resilience in October, generating over $400 million of net inflows across U.S., International Developed, and Emerging Market equities
- The[first two actively managed defined return UCITS ETFs](https://www.wisdomtree.com/gb/press-room/wisdomtree-launches-actively-managed-defined-return-etfs) launched, leveraging Atlantic House’s product development capabilities; these products attracted $64 million of net inflows in their first month of trading in October, marking a strong start to our broader liquid alternatives product rollout

**About WisdomTree**


WisdomTree is a modern global asset manager with capabilities across public markets, private markets, tokenization and onchain finance. We offer a diverse suite of exchange-traded products, models and solutions, private market investments and blockchain-enabled products and services, helping investors shape their financial future and financial professionals grow their businesses. Through WisdomTree Onchain™, we combine tokenized investment products, infrastructure and distribution capabilities into an integrated financial services platform serving retail and institutional investors.


WisdomTree currently has approximately $173.9 billion in assets under management globally, inclusive of assets managed by Ceres Partners, LLC as of the last reportable period.
